repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate introduced an absolute-value folding logic (lines 5-7) to handle negative differences, which is not present in the IR. The IR strictly computes $t2 - t1$ and checks if the result is >= 3. In the counterexample, the temperature dropped (t2 < t1), making the difference negative; the IR correctly does nothing, but the candidate flipped the difference to positive and triggered the action. This violates the exact arithmetic direction and operand order required by the IR.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the absolute-value folding block (lines 5-7) and simplified the guard to match the IR's exact expression ($t2 - t1 >= 3$). This ensures the action only fires when the temperature rises by at least 3 units, preserving the IR's specific behavior.
